aggregate.note: FP = detections factually wrong per code review: (1) session_fixation on logout functions that do invalidate; (2) Authorization (Ownership Check) on functions whose body contains an inline ownerId/authorId comparison. Factually-true detections not in the gold list are 'unlabeled' and excluded from precision — mirrors v5 annotation_issues handling. Matching is strict-localization: a finding counts as detected only when ITS function carries the corresponding rule; the handleRequest aggregator fallback applies only to functions absent from the scan.
